title: Incrementing an enumerated binary word
statement: For natural numbers $w$ and $v$ satisfying $v+1<2^w$, applying fixed-width binary increment to the width-$w$ little-endian binary word of $v$ yields the width-$w$ little-endian binary word of $v+1$.
